#{studentId}
SELECT a.id, a.head, a.type, a.updated_date_time FROM article a WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY a.updated_date_time DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT t.id, t.student_id, t.type, t.head, t.content, t.release_date_time, t.updated_date_time, t.name, t.avatar FROM (SELECT a.*, s.name AS name, f.file_url AS avatar, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.type ORDER BY a.updated_date_time DESC, a.id DESC ) AS row_num FROM article a LEFT JOIN it_student s ON s.student_id = a.student_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_file f ON f.id = s.avatar_id) t WHERE t.row_num <= #{size} ORDER BY t.type, t.updated_date_time DESC, t.id DESC
